cards.card_text: And the last line sums up the whole thing: Esau was the father of the Edomites.
cards.verse_text: Esau was the father of the Edomites.
cards.snippet: Esau was the father of the Edomites.

cards.card_text: First, Moses says, "Do not despise an Edomite…"
cards.verse_text: Do not despise an Edomite, for he is your brother.
cards.snippet: Do not despise an Edomite, for he is your brother.

cards.card_text: Why shouldn't Israel despise an Edomite?
cards.verse_text: Do not despise an Edomite, for he is your brother.
cards.snippet: Do not despise an Edomite, for he is your brother.

cards.card_text: From the time Saul takes the kingship over Israel, he fights enemies on every side: the Moabites, the Ammonites, the Edomites, the kings of Zobah and the Philistines.
cards.verse_text: After Saul had assumed the kingship over Israel, he fought against all his enemies on every side—the Moabites, the Ammonites, the Edomites, the kings of Zobah, and the Philistines.
cards.snippet: …fought against all his enemies on every side—the Moabites, the Ammonites, the Edomites, the kings of Zobah, and the Philistines.

cards.card_text: But hold on, friend, because someone else is at Nob that day, detained before the LORD, and his name is Doeg the Edomite.
cards.verse_text: And his name was Doeg the Edomite, the chief shepherd for Saul.
cards.snippet: And his name was Doeg the Edomite, the chief shepherd for Saul.

cards.card_text: Doeg the Edomite is at Nob that day.
cards.verse_text: And his name was Doeg the Edomite, the chief shepherd for Saul.
cards.snippet: And his name was Doeg the Edomite, the chief shepherd for Saul.

cards.card_text: Then Doeg the Edomite speaks up.
cards.verse_text: But Doeg the Edomite, who had stationed himself with Saul’s servants, answered: “I saw the son of Jesse come to Ahimelech son of Ahitub at Nob.
cards.snippet: But Doeg the Edomite, who had stationed himself with Saul’s servants, answered: “I saw the son…

cards.card_text: So Saul gives the order to Doeg the Edomite, and Doeg turns and strikes down the priests himself.
cards.verse_text: So the king ordered Doeg, “You turn and strike down the priests!” And Doeg the Edomite turned and struck down the priests himself.
cards.snippet: …ordered Doeg, “You turn and strike down the priests!” And Doeg the Edomite turned and struck down the priests himself.

cards.card_text: David returns from striking down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
cards.verse_text: And David made a name for himself when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
cards.snippet: …a name for himself when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

cards.card_text: True or false: Even with David's garrisons in Edom, some of the Edomites stay free of him.
cards.verse_text: He placed garrisons throughout Edom, and all the Edomites were subject to David.
cards.snippet: He placed garrisons throughout Edom, and all the Edomites were subject to David.

cards.card_text: Now trouble starts showing up, and the first name on the list is Hadad the Edomite, from the royal line of Edom.
cards.verse_text: Then the LORD raised up against Solomon an adversary, Hadad the Edomite, from the royal line of Edom.
cards.snippet: Then the LORD raised up against Solomon an adversary, Hadad the Edomite, from the royal line of Edom.

cards.card_text: It's the LORD who raised up Hadad the Edomite as an adversary against Solomon.
cards.verse_text: Then the LORD raised up against Solomon an adversary, Hadad the Edomite, from the royal line of Edom.
cards.snippet: Then the LORD raised up against Solomon an adversary, Hadad the Edomite, from the royal line of Edom.

cards.card_text: So how is Hadad the Edomite still alive to be Solomon's adversary?
cards.verse_text: But Hadad, still just a young boy, had fled to Egypt, along with some Edomites who were servants of his father.
cards.snippet: …still just a young boy, had fled to Egypt, along with some Edomites who were servants of his father.

cards.card_text: So Jehoram crosses over to Zair with ALL his chariots, and the Edomites surround him and his chariot commanders anyway.
cards.verse_text: When the Edomites surrounded him and his chariot commanders, he rose up and attacked by night.
cards.snippet: When the Edomites surrounded him and his chariot commanders, he rose up and attacked by…

cards.card_text: Jehoram is surrounded by the Edomites at Zair.
cards.verse_text: When the Edomites surrounded him and his chariot commanders, he rose up and attacked by night.
cards.snippet: When the Edomites surrounded him and his chariot commanders, he rose up and attacked by…

cards.card_text: Then Amaziah goes to war against the Edomites, the people descended from Esau (Genesis 36:9).
cards.verse_text: Amaziah struck down 10,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
cards.snippet: Amaziah struck down 10,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

cards.card_text: How many Edomites does Amaziah strike down in the Valley of Salt?
cards.verse_text: Amaziah struck down 10,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
cards.snippet: Amaziah struck down 10,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

cards.card_text: He sends the Edomites into Elath, and they're still living there when this was written.
cards.verse_text: At that time Rezin king of Aram recovered Elath for Aram, drove out the men of Judah, and sent the Edomites into Elath, where they live to this day.
cards.snippet: …Elath for Aram, drove out the men of Judah, and sent the Edomites into Elath, where they live to this day.

cards.card_text: Abishai, son of David's sister Zeruiah (1 Chronicles 2:16), strikes down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
cards.verse_text: Moreover, Abishai son of Zeruiah struck down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
cards.snippet: Moreover, Abishai son of Zeruiah struck down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

cards.card_text: After the battle in the Valley of Salt, true or false: only some of the Edomites become subject to David.
cards.verse_text: He placed garrisons in Edom, and all the Edomites were subject to David.
cards.snippet: He placed garrisons in Edom, and all the Edomites were subject to David.

cards.card_text: Then the Edomites surround Jehoram and his chariot commanders, like a surprise party where NOBODY is happy to see you.
cards.verse_text: When the Edomites surrounded him and his chariot commanders, he rose up and attacked by night.
cards.snippet: When the Edomites surrounded him and his chariot commanders, he rose up and attacked by…

cards.card_text: Surrounded by the Edomites, what does Jehoram do?
cards.verse_text: When the Edomites surrounded him and his chariot commanders, he rose up and attacked by night.
cards.snippet: When the Edomites surrounded him and his chariot commanders, he rose up and attacked by…

cards.card_text: Amaziah summons his strength and leads his troops to the Valley of Salt to fight the men of Seir, the Edomites.
cards.verse_text: Amaziah, however, summoned his strength and led his troops to the Valley of Salt, where he struck down 10,000 men of Seir, When Amaziah returned from the slaughter of the Edomites, he brought back the gods of the Seirites, set them up as his own gods, bowed before them, and burned sacrifices to them.
cards.snippet: …10,000 men of Seir, When Amaziah returned from the slaughter of the Edomites, he brought back the gods of the Seirites, set them up as…

cards.card_text: Now Amaziah comes home from beating the Edomites.
cards.verse_text: When Amaziah returned from the slaughter of the Edomites, he brought back the gods of the Seirites, set them up as his own gods, bowed before them, and burned sacrifices to them.
cards.snippet: When Amaziah returned from the slaughter of the Edomites, he brought back the gods of the Seirites, set them up as…

cards.card_text: The Edomites have attacked Judah again and carried off captives, and the Philistines have raided Judah's towns, capturing places like Beth-shemesh and Timnah.
cards.verse_text: The Edomites had again come and attacked Judah and carried away captives.
cards.snippet: The Edomites had again come and attacked Judah and carried away captives.

cards.card_text: This one's a Maskil of David, the man who later became king of Israel (2 Samuel 5:3), from after Doeg the Edomite, one of Saul's servants (1 Samuel 21:7), went to King Saul and told him, “David has gone to the house of Ahimelech.” Ahimelech was a priest (1 Samuel 21:1).
cards.verse_text: After Doeg the Edomite went to Saul and told him, “David has gone to the house of Ahimelech.” Why do you boast of evil, O mighty man?
cards.snippet: After Doeg the Edomite went to Saul and told him, “David has gone to the house…

cards.card_text: David, Israel's king, wrote this song for the choirmaster, back when he fought Aram-naharaim and Aram-zobah, and Joab, commander of David's army (2 Samuel 8:16), came back and struck down 12,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
cards.verse_text: When he fought Aram-naharaim and Aram-zobah, and Joab returned and struck down 12,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
cards.snippet: …he fought Aram-naharaim and Aram-zobah, and Joab returned and struck down 12,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
